summary: Quarantined articles and articles still queued for screening leave every group C count (keyword frequency, ring split by country, the source-country and server maps and their coverage rollup, associations and the keyword graph with the corpus-wide counter's queued share taken off at query time, who and where with their denominators, map data, link totals and top cited, link and outlet furniture, the conjunction counts and trend, the dossier's routes, passport and rails, place mention counts, the Wikidata fetch order, the Home detectors and corpus size); lists keep them, and the conjunction and the dossier say N of these results not counted yet. Status totals (Insights, Library) count every article and say of which quarantined, of which not screened yet. The agenda's deduced dates are read in timemap/datestore.py under the import hold, so each says it may include them; the post-hold correction is one not_counted filter in upcoming_deduced and deduced_date_article_ids. The map coverage rollup records the slice's two counts and rebuilds when they move. Query time only (R755); exports unchanged. tests/test_group_c_slice.py pins each site by source and lists the exceptions with their reasons.
